description_en: Deletes the backup sets of a PolarDB cluster
name: DeleteBackup

parameters.description_en:
The backup ID. If you need to specify multiple backup IDs, separate the backup IDs with commas (,).

>  You can call the [DescribeBackups](~~98102~~) operation to query the backup IDs.
parameters.description_zh:
备份ID，多个备份之间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
 
> 您可以通过[DescribeBackups](~~98102~~)接口查询BackupId。
